title: Productboard connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [Productboard connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/productboard) is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

Use the connector to ingest product hierarchy, roadmap, objectives, customer feedback notes, and workspace member data from Productboard into Databricks. The connector uses Server-to-Server OAuth authentication and supports incremental ingestion for notes, UI-based pipeline authoring, Declarative Automation Bundles, and API-based pipeline authoring.
